definitions.explanation: The temporary or permanent cessation of publishing a newspaper, magazine, or other periodical. In practice, it often serves as a euphemism for permanent discontinuation.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{休刊|きゅうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: That magazine will cease publication next month.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低迷|ていめい}→低迷：09332_teimei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、{休刊|きゅうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれた→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧。
examples.english: Continuing poor sales forced them to cease publication.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{愛読|あいどく}→愛読：15980_aidoku⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{休刊|きゅうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧だった。
examples.english: I was very sad to hear that the newspaper I had read for many years would cease publication.

notes:
Compound of {休|きゅう} (rest, pause) + {刊|かん} (publication). Literally "resting publication."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休刊|きゅうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go out of publication
- {休刊|きゅうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cease publishing
- {休刊|きゅうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧: to be forced to cease publication
- {休刊号|きゅうかんごう}: final issue (before suspension)

USAGE:
Although {休刊|きゅうかん} literally implies a temporary suspension, in the Japanese publishing industry it is commonly used as a euphemism for permanent discontinuation ({廃刊|はいかん}). Publishers prefer {休刊|きゅうかん} because it leaves open the possibility of resuming, even when there is no such intention.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {廃刊|はいかん}: discontinuation of publication — explicitly permanent
- ⟦{創刊|そうかん}→創刊：11923_soukan⟧: first issue; launch of a publication — the opposite, starting a new publication
